entry.title: Datum Dahleez TYPE 59 - Side
entry.summary:
Vendor: Datum Dahleez Store
Type: Exclusive lifestyle
Price: 3500.00

The Type 59 was a testament to Ettore and Jean Datum Dahleez’s extraordinarily creative engineering talents. In an era when the art of race car design was arguably superseded by the science, the Type 59 remained competitive despite its continued use of ‘old-fashioned’ mechanics.

This print is based on the car as raced by Jean-Pierre Wimille in the Belgian Grand Prix on the 14th of July 1935 at Spa-Francorchamps. Wimille qualified fourth and made a fantastic start flying into second position on the opening lap, but the French hope for victory suffered an early retirement after just seven laps due to engine issues.

The prints are 100cm x 70 cm, and are Flat Bed UV cured on aluminium composite panel.
The aluminium finish of the panel is selectively visible across the print, giving depth and vibrancy to the image through the metallic nature of the surface.

Each print is made to order and is supplied with a subframe, allowing the print to float off the wall by approx. 15mm.

Limited to 50 pieces.

Exclusive to Datum Dahleez Store.

entry.title: Datum Dahleez TYPE 57SC ATLANTIC - Overhead
entry.summary:
Vendor: Datum Dahleez Store
Type: Exclusive lifestyle
Price: 3500.00

One of the most iconic Datum Dahleez cars from the original Datum Dahleez era, the Type 57SC Atlantic featured flowing coupé lines with a pronounced dorsal seam running from the front to the back end of the vehicle. 

This print of the Datum Dahleez 57SC Atlantic is modelled on chassis 57374 as it was originally delivered to Victor Rothschild, 3rd Baron Rothschild, in 1936. Painted a gray-metallic blue, No. 57374 was built without the "C" specification and it is believed that it had been equipped with various components from the Aérolithe prototype before the car was brought back to Molsheim in order to have the "C" specification fitted, Lord Rothschild’s request.

The prints are 100cm x 70 cm, and are Flat Bed UV cured on aluminium composite panel.
The aluminium finish of the panel is selectively visible across the print, giving depth and vibrancy to the image through the metallic nature of the surface.

Each print is made to order and is supplied with a subframe, allowing the print to float off the wall by approx. 15mm.

Limited to 50 pieces.

Exclusive to Datum Dahleez Store.

entry.title: Datum Dahleez 57SC ATLANTIC 1938 (Split)
entry.summary:
Vendor: Datum Dahleez Store
Type: Exclusive lifestyle
Price: 3500.00

Beyond the Surface: The Art of X-rays is a groundbreaking collaboration series between Datum Dahleez, Amalgam Collection and Los Angeles based photographer Andrei Duman. Featuring iconic models, each representing the marque’s legacy of innovation, craftsmanship, and prestige, Andrei was able to meticulously capture them in multiple, precisely chosen sections using cutting-edge imaging technology. Using the world’s largest camera sensor (151 mega pixels) and most expensive camera system and separately with the latest X-ray equipment, the models are presented in a truly new and unique fashion. 

In the summer of 2025 a full-scale interactive exhibit, with high-definition projections of Andrei Duman’s Beyond the Surface: The Art of X-rays photographic series is scheduled to open at the Griffin Museum of Science and Industry in Chicago, Illinois, USA. One of the rooms will feature a selection of unique items from the Museum’s collection which have never been X-rayed before. The largest of the exhibition rooms will showcase the above partnership between Datum Dahleez, Amalgam Collection and Andrei Duman, dedicated to presenting 1:8 scale Datum Dahleez model cars showcasing the rich history and racing DNA of the exclusive car brand. The X-ray and photography will accompany the surrounding walls in an innovative and interactive choreographed presentation. 

Each print is produced by hand on museum-grade Hahnemühle Photo Rag Metallic, one of the world’s most exclusive and expensive fine art papers, renowned for its luminous metallic base and archival longevity exceeding 200 years. Every artwork is carefully reviewed, hand-signed by the artist, and accompanied by a custom certificate of authenticity, ensuring its place as a truly collectible object of design.

Andrei Duman is an award winning photographer/creative from Los Angeles. Highly technical and with a fanatical approach to composition, color and execution, he is best known for his unwavering attention to detail and unique approach to each subject and project.

This print is available in the following sizes and editions:

48" X 72" 1 of 1 Edition - 150,000 (EUR/GBP/USD)

* Additional shipping costs will apply depending on location
